_comment: Ground truth for probe.ogg, used by transcribe.py --verify-providers. The sentence is deliberately absurd so no model can produce these words by guessing from a prompt: a provider that drops the audio and hallucinates cannot accidentally pass. Discovered 2026-08-21, when a local router advertised audioInput:true, silently discarded the audio, and returned invented meeting-shaped text for six of seven models.
sentence: The violet kangaroo audits seventeen bridges in Lisbon.
_min_keywords_note: 3 of 5 tolerates ordinary transcription error (seventeen->17, Lisbon->lisbon) while still being impossible to hit by chance.
